goal: Adds an opt-in kernel API to trace script evaluation step by step for external tooling
Enables building script debuggers, visualizers, and fuzzers on top of libbitcoinkernel
reviewability: Paused: waiting on author for 15+ days after a concrete crash bug report
w0xlt found a reachable assert failure and a frame-skipping bug, both unaddressed
agreement: Concept approval because it enables real external tooling (furszy, w0xlt, theStack, haanhvu)
Unaddressed objection: assert crashes when serror is null, hit by real callers (w0xlt)
Unaddressed objection: oversized scripts silently drop BEGIN/END frames (w0xlt)
Extensive earlier review feedback was incorporated by the author over months

categories.name: kernel
why: P2 because it adds a genuinely new opt-in capability with a real external consumer already using it
Off by default so it carries no risk to existing kernel consumers
Marginal for now since a real bug in the feature itself remains unfixed before it can be relied on
